record.one_liner: Help Scout is a shared-inbox customer support platform with email, chat, a knowledge base (Docs) and reporting.
record.auth_notes: Mailbox API 2.0 uses OAuth 2.0 only. Authorization Code is for third-party integrations other users authorize. Client Credentials is for internal integrations. Apps are created under Your Profile > My apps. Tokens are sent as Bearer headers and expire after 48 hours. The Authorization Code flow also issues refresh tokens. The Docs API separately uses an API key, which I saw mentioned on the MCP page but did not fetch the Docs API page to confirm.
record.access_notes: The Free plan has no API access. Standard is the cheapest paid tier, with up to 200 calls/min and all endpoints except reporting. Plus allows 400 calls/min and Pro 800, and both include reporting. A search result said Standard and Plus have a 15-day no-card trial, but I did not confirm this on a fetched vendor page. That table comes from a docs page dated Jan 2025. Prices were not checked.
record.blocker: The API needs a paid plan (Standard or higher), and Standard has no reporting endpoints. Rate limits are shared account-wide, and writes and searches count double. The official MCP server is read-only for new connections.
